column3: Alias "Plain Girl"
You... You can understand Kirino's mind?
I can't. I am just guessing.
I'm sure Kirino-chan relies on you.
Huh!?
How did you even come up with that conclusion?
You are a lucky big brother.
No way! That girl couldn't possibly be relying on me!
That girl isn't such a nice sister!
That's not true.
It is! I know it!
Oh really?
That's for sure! So, I think it's better that Kyou-chan should be more confident.
Although, that's absolutely impossible... I never thought she would say something like that to me.
Is this the power of a childhood friend?
That's because...
That's because of what?
I rely on Kyou-chan on some things as well.
W-What are you saying?! So suddenly...!
You're embarrassed now～
I-I-I'm not embarrassed!
Hehe. You're hiding your embarrassment. Kyou-chan is so cute.
...Ah, really...
Ah, really... Is that all?
What else could I say?
Geez...
Even I... always thought about being of help to Kyou-chan, you know?
Don't bother.
Buuh... So mean...
I won't rely on you.
Hmm? Then I won't help you study from now on.
I was wrong! Manami, thank you for everything!
This girl... She naturally said some really embarrassing things again...
